description: Copy an existing ad set. Creates a duplicate within the same or different campaign.

adset_id.description: Source ad set ID to copy

campaign_id.description: Target campaign ID. If omitted, copies to same campaign

deep_copy.description: Copy ads within the ad set (default true)

name.description: Name for the copied ad set

status.description: Status for copied ad set (default PAUSED)

name: copy_adset
